title: Emby Library Scan Failure Count
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emby:session event=library_scan
| stats count(eval(result="error")) as failures by library
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Uses Emby library scans telemetry to monitor which libraries are failing to scan cleanly in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for content sources that need repair before metadata goes stale, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Emby library scans data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It records which libraries are failing to scan cleanly so you can spot content sources that need repair before metadata goes stale before it becomes annoying.
